# `time`

Game time. Gameplay should use the `dt` its callback receives (or `time.delta()`), so `time.set_scale` and `time.set_paused` slow down, speed up or stop it; a pause menu keeps working because `on_update` and UI events still run.

```lua
function Menu.on_update(self, dt)
    if input.pressed("pause") then
        time.set_paused(not time.is_paused())
    end
end
```

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| [`time`](#time-1) | Game time: the frame's delta, elapsed time, time scale and pause. |
| [`time.delta`](#timedelta) | Seconds of game time this frame (scaled; 0 while paused). |
| [`time.elapsed`](#timeelapsed) | Seconds of game time since the game started (scaled, stops while paused). |
| [`time.frame`](#timeframe) | The number of frames since the game started. |
| [`time.scale`](#timescale) | The time scale: 1 is normal speed, 0.5 half speed. |
| [`time.set_scale`](#timeset_scale) | Sets the time scale (clamped at 0). |

| [`time.set_paused`](#timeset_paused) | Pauses or resumes game time: `dt` becomes 0, fixed steps and waits stop, `on_update` still runs (for menus). |

## `time`

Game time: the frame's delta, elapsed time, time scale and pause.

### `time.delta`

```luau
function time.delta(): number
```

Seconds of game time this frame (scaled; 0 while paused). Inside `on_fixed_update` it is the fixed step.

### `time.elapsed`

```luau
function time.elapsed(): number
```

Seconds of game time since the game started (scaled, stops while paused).

### `time.frame`

```luau
function time.frame(): number
```

The number of frames since the game started.

### `time.scale`

```luau
function time.scale(): number
```

The time scale: 1 is normal speed, 0.5 half speed.

### `time.set_scale`

```luau
function time.set_scale(scale: number)
```

Sets the time scale (clamped at 0). Slows or speeds up `dt`, waits, physics and animation.

### `time.is_paused`

```luau
function time.is_paused(): boolean
```

True while game time is paused.

### `time.paused`

```luau
function time.paused(): boolean
```

Deprecated: use `is_paused`.

### `time.set_paused`

```luau
function time.set_paused(paused: boolean)
```

Pauses or resumes game time: `dt` becomes 0, fixed steps and waits stop, `on_update` still runs (for menus).

### `time.fixed_step`

```luau
function time.fixed_step(): number
```

The fixed step in seconds (1/60 by default): the `dt` of `on_fixed_update`.
